slides.ingredients: 1 Rust binary, 2 Docker containers, 3 CI stages, 1 health check endpoint, CDN to taste
slides.step1: Build your Rust binary with cargo build --release and verify all tests pass.
slides.step2: Package into a minimal Docker image using multi-stage build to keep it under 20MB.
slides.step3: Deploy to production with zero-downtime rolling update and monitor health checks.
